task: T7.5 - structured logs and env-optional Sentry

mutants.name: M-log-level-channel
mutants.kills: an error must land on the error channel, not merely somewhere

mutants.name: M-log-one-line
mutants.kills: one entry is one line - a pretty-printed entry breaks every aggregator

mutants.name: M-log-clock-injection
mutants.kills: the timestamp comes from the injected clock, so tests assert a literal

mutants.name: M-log-sink-injection
mutants.kills: an injected sink replaces the console rather than being ignored

mutants.name: M-log-correlation-key
mutants.anchor: return createLogger({ key: "request_id", value: requestId }, options, {});
mutants.replacement: return createLogger({ key: "job_id", value: requestId }, options, {});
mutants.kills: a request logger emits request_id, not job_id

mutants.name: M-log-reserved-keys
mutants.kills: a caller-supplied field cannot relabel level/time/msg/request_id

mutants.name: M-log-correlation-missing-off
mutants.kills: a blank correlation id is flagged, so untraceable lines are greppable

mutants.name: M-log-correlation-missing-always
mutants.kills: the flag is not stamped on a line that HAS an id

mutants.name: M-log-with-bound-fields
mutants.kills: fields bound by with() appear on every later entry

mutants.name: M-log-error-serialize
mutants.kills: THE TRAP - an Error handed straight to JSON.stringify becomes {}

mutants.name: M-log-error-stack
mutants.kills: the stack survives - 'which line threw' is the whole point

mutants.name: M-log-error-cause
mutants.kills: the cause chain survives - the real fault is usually at the bottom

mutants.name: M-log-error-code
mutants.kills: a driver error code (23505, 42501) survives

mutants.name: M-log-error-cross-realm
mutants.kills: an Error from another realm is still serialized, not silently emptied

mutants.name: M-log-redact-keys-off
mutants.kills: every secret-shaped key is redacted

mutants.name: M-log-redact-keys-everything
mutants.kills: route/user_id/receipt_id are NOT redacted - over-redaction is also a defect

mutants.name: M-log-redact-at-emit
mutants.anchor: entry[key] = isSensitiveKey(key) ? REDACTED : walk(value, 1, new WeakSet<object>());
mutants.kills: a top-level secret field is redacted, including one bound by with()

mutants.name: M-log-redact-nested
mutants.anchor: result[key] = isSensitiveKey(key) ? REDACTED : walk(entry, depth + 1, seen);
mutants.kills: redaction reaches inside nested objects and arrays, not just the top

mutants.name: M-log-redact-jwt
mutants.kills: a JWT is redacted by shape even under an innocent key

mutants.name: M-log-redact-bearer
mutants.kills: a bearer credential is redacted by shape even under an innocent key

mutants.name: M-log-circular
mutants.kills: a cycle is named, not walked

mutants.name: M-log-circular-siblings
mutants.kills: a shared sibling object is printed twice, not misreported as a cycle

mutants.name: M-log-depth-cap
mutants.kills: the walk stops at a depth cap

mutants.name: M-log-array-cap
mutants.kills: a capped array says how many entries it dropped

mutants.name: M-log-string-cap
mutants.kills: a huge string is truncated rather than becoming the log line

mutants.name: M-log-bigint
mutants.kills: a bigint does not make JSON.stringify throw the entry away

mutants.name: M-log-nonfinite
mutants.kills: NaN/Infinity are named, not silently emitted as null

mutants.name: M-log-headers
mutants.replacement: if (false && typeof Headers !== "undefined" && object instanceof Headers) {
mutants.kills: a Headers instance does not stringify to {} (the Error trap, again)

mutants.name: M-log-map
mutants.kills: a Map does not stringify to {}

mutants.name: M-log-set
mutants.kills: a Set does not stringify to {}

mutants.name: M-log-date
mutants.kills: a Date renders as an ISO string

mutants.name: M-log-invalid-date
mutants.kills: an invalid Date is named rather than throwing the entry away

mutants.name: M-log-regexp
mutants.kills: a RegExp does not stringify to {}

mutants.name: M-log-never-throws
mutants.anchor:
} catch {
      // NEVER THE REASON SOMETHING FAILS.
mutants.kills: a broken sink or clock never replaces the fault being reported

mutants.name: M-log-release
mutants.kills: 'on which deploy' - the commit sha is stamped on the line

mutants.name: M-log-release-blank
mutants.kills: off-platform the key is omitted, not emitted as an empty string
